title: Vulnerabilities
description: CVEs that apply to what's running (advisory-map): applications, Talos, Kubernetes and the VMs' Debian packages, with known-exploited ones flagged.

list.name: kev
list.label: Exploited
list.query: Any : true|false, Known exploited only : true

panels.title: Critical
panels.description: CVEs rated critical that apply now (each counted once, however many targets), unconfirmed ones aside.

targets.expr: count(count by (cve) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{severity="critical", status!="unconfirmed", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: High
panels.description: CVEs rated high that apply now (each counted once, however many targets), unconfirmed ones aside.

targets.expr: count(count by (cve) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{severity="high", status!="unconfirmed", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Medium
panels.description: CVEs rated medium that apply now (each counted once, however many targets), unconfirmed ones aside.

targets.expr: count(count by (cve) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{severity="medium", status!="unconfirmed", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Low
panels.description: CVEs rated low that apply now (each counted once, however many targets), unconfirmed ones aside.

targets.expr: count(count by (cve) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{severity="low", status!="unconfirmed", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Fix available
panels.description: CVEs with a fixed version released for at least one target: upgrading clears them.

targets.expr: count(count by (cve) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{status="fix-available", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: No fix yet
panels.description: CVEs without a fixed version for a target (open, or Debian's no-dsa, postponed, ignored, undetermined).

targets.expr: count(count by (cve) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{status!~"fix-available|unconfirmed", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Known exploited
panels.description: CVEs in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue.

targets.expr: count(count by (cve) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{kev="true", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Unconfirmed
panels.description: CVEs whose record lists older affected releases and leaves the rest affected by default: the installed version is outside the listed ranges, so check the vendor's advisory.

targets.expr: count(count by (cve) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{status="unconfirmed", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: CVEs by severity
panels.description: CVEs that applied over time, by severity (each counted once per severity it has).

targets.expr: count by (severity) (count by (cve, severity) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{status!="unconfirmed", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"}))

panels.title: Fix available, by target
panels.description: CVEs with a fixed version per target: what an upgrade there would clear.

targets.expr: sort_desc(count by (target) (count by (target, cve) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{status="fix-available", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})))

panels.title: CVEs by target
panels.description: Containers, Helm releases, Talos, Kubernetes and the VMs' binaries, matched through advisory-map's mapping against the CVE List (cve.org) and OSV. Click a CVE for its record.

targets.expr: label_replace(advisory_map_vulnerability_info{source="osv", target_kind!="debian-package", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"}, "record", "https://osv.dev/vulnerability/$1", "cve", "(.+)") or label_replace(advisory_map_vulnerability_info{source="cve.org", target_kind!="debian-package", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"}, "record", "https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=$1", "cve", "(.+)")

panels.title: CVEs by package
panels.description: The VMs' packages against the Debian Security Tracker, by source package: one row per CVE and package, with how many hosts have it (pick a host in Target for its own). Click a CVE for the tracker.

targets.expr: count by (cve, severity, package, fixed_version, status, kev, kev_ransomware) (advisory_map_vulnerability_info{target_kind="debian-package", source=~"$source", target_kind=~"$target_kind", target=~"$target", severity=~"$severity", status=~"$status", kev=~"$kev"})

panels.title: Feed age
panels.description: Since each feed last refreshed: red past two days (twice the daily refresh).

panels.title: Last match
panels.description: Since versions were last matched: red past 30 minutes (twice the match interval).

panels.title: Hosts without packages
panels.description: Debian hosts whose package list is missing (no dpkg textfile): their packages aren't checked.

panels.title: Unmapped images
panels.description: Running images no mapping entry covers: not checked (listed below).

panels.title: Unmatched ranges
panels.description: Affected ranges that couldn't be compared with an installed version (listed below by reason): neither findings nor dismissed.

panels.title: Unmapped images
panels.description: Running images no mapping entry covers.

panels.title: Unmatched ranges
panels.description: Affected ranges that couldn't be compared, by source and reason: git (commits, not versions), unspecified or unparsable versions, ecosystem (an OSV ecosystem without a list of versions).
